question: För vilket belopp tecknade Workday avtal om att förvärva det svenska AI-bolaget Sana i september 2025?

question: Hur stor var Lovables serie C-runda i augusti 2026, till vilken värdering skedde den och vilka ledde rundan?

question: När slutfördes amerikanska Lytens köp av Northvolts svenska verksamhet och vad omfattade affären?

golds.fact: Lyten's acquisition of bankrupt Northvolt's Swedish operations (including the Skellefteå factory) was completed in February 2026, in a deal valued at about $5 billion, with plans to hire around 600 people

question: Hur och när börsnoterades svenska Einride i USA, och till vilken värdering skedde noteringen?

golds.fact: Einride began trading on Nasdaq on June 10, 2026 under ticker ENRD after completing its SPAC merger with Legato Merger Corp. III at a pre-money valuation of roughly $1.35 billion
Einride raised $113m in an oversubscribed PIPE financing (including EQT Ventures) ahead of its SPAC listing in New York

question: On what terms did Norway's 1X Technologies open consumer preorders for its NEO home humanoid robot in October 2025?

golds.fact: 1X opened preorders for the NEO humanoid at $20,000 for Early Access (with a $200 deposit) or a $499/month subscription, with first deliveries to US homes in 2026

question: Varför gick den norska batteritillverkaren Morrow Batteries i konkurs i maj 2026, och vilken statlig kreditgivare hade störst exponering?

golds.fact: Morrow Batteries ASA and its subsidiaries resolved to file for bankruptcy on May 6, 2026 after failing to secure a new industrial investor and financing; state lender Innovasjon Norge had extended loans of about NOK 550 million

question: How much funding did Danish payments fintech Flatpay secure when it became Denmark's latest unicorn in November 2025?

golds.fact: Flatpay raised $170 million (€145m), becoming the fastest Danish company to reach unicorn status, in a round involving AVP, Smash Capital and existing investors including Dawn Capital

question: Who led Finnish quantum computing company IQM's Series B round announced in September 2025, and how large was the round?

golds.fact: IQM Quantum Computers raised a $320m Series B led by US firm Ten Eleven Ventures, its first American backing
The Series B, backed by Ten Eleven Ventures with strong support from Finnish state investor Tesi, brought IQM's total funding to around $600 million

question: What valuation did Finnish smart ring maker Oura reach with its Series E round in October 2025, and who led the round?

golds.fact: Oura hit an $11bn valuation after raising $900m in a Series E led by Fidelity Management & Research Company, with new investor ICONIQ, Whale Rock and Atreides participating

question: How much did Finnish radar satellite company ICEYE raise in June 2026, and at what valuation?

golds.fact: ICEYE raised €1bn in a round led by General Atlantic valuing the company at around €10bn, with €450m in new funding and the remainder secondaries

question: Till vilken teckningskurs prissattes Klarnas börsnotering på New York-börsen i september 2025, och hur utvecklades aktien under första handelsdagen?

golds.fact: Klarnas introduktionskurs på New York-börsen blev 40 dollar per aktie, vilket värderade bolaget till cirka 15 miljarder dollar (omkring 140 miljarder kronor); bolaget tog in cirka 1,37 miljarder dollar
Klarna-aktien steg cirka 30 procent i den inledande handeln den 10 september 2025 och handlades upp mot 52 dollar

question: Hur många tjänster meddelade Novo Nordisk att man skär bort i omstruktureringen i september 2025, och hur många av dem i Danmark?

golds.fact: Novo Nordisk announced on 10 September 2025 it would cut 9,000 positions globally, of which 5,000 in Denmark, targeting annual savings of DKK 8 billion — the largest layoff round in company history

question: Vilka tar över som vd för Spotify när Daniel Ek lämnar vd-posten, och när träder förändringen i kraft?

golds.fact: Daniel Ek lämnar vd-posten och blir arbetande styrelseordförande; Gustav Söderström och Alex Norström blir co-vd:ar, med förändringen i kraft den 1 januari 2026

question: Hur stor andel av Ørsteds nyemission på 60 miljarder danska kronor tecknades när kapitalanskaffningen slutfördes i oktober 2025?

golds.fact: Ørsted completed its DKK 60 billion rights issue on 6 October 2025 with 99.3 percent of the new shares subscribed by existing shareholders or holders of subscription rights, with the Danish state participating; proceeds finance Revolution Wind and other committed projects

question: Hur stort blev Volvo Cars rörelseresultat för tredje kvartalet 2025 jämfört med förväntningarna, och hur reagerade aktien på rapporten?

golds.fact: Volvo Cars redovisade ett rörelseresultat (ebit) på 6,4 miljarder kronor för Q3 2025 mot väntade cirka 1,4 miljarder, och aktien rusade cirka 35 procent den 23 oktober 2025, förstärkt av blankares panikköp

question: Hur stor ägarandel fick Nvidia i Nokia genom aktieinvesteringen som meddelades i oktober 2025, och hur reagerade Nokias aktiekurs?

golds.fact: Nvidia announced on 28 October 2025 a $1 billion (about €860 million) investment in Nokia via a directed share issue at $6.01 per share, giving it roughly a 2.9 percent stake, as part of an AI-networks partnership
Nokia's shares surged over 20 percent in Helsinki and about 25 percent in New York on the announcement, reaching their highest level in nearly a decade

question: Vilken avkastning redovisade norska oljefonden (Statens pensjonsfond utland) för 2025, och hur mycket var fonden värd vid årsskiftet?

golds.fact: The Norwegian oil fund reported a 2025 return of 15.1 percent, equal to NOK 2,362 billion, with the fund valued at NOK 21,268 billion at end-2025; equities returned 19.3 percent and Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft were the largest holdings

question: How many Nvidia Rubin GPUs will Nscale's Narvik data center campus be equipped with under the expanded Microsoft agreement announced in April 2026?

golds.fact: Nscale announced an expansion of its Microsoft agreement to deliver AI capacity from Narvik, with the campus to be equipped with more than 30,000 Nvidia Rubin processors in a 230 MW facility planned for completion in 2027

question: Hur många Gripenplan köper Ukraina av Sverige enligt beskedet i maj 2026, och hur många begagnade plan donerar Sverige därutöver?

golds.fact: Ukraina köper 20 Gripen E/F av Sverige, och Sverige donerar därefter 16 begagnade Gripen C/D; leveranser väntas från 2030, enligt beskedet den 28 maj 2026

question: At what valuation did Finland's IQM go public in July 2026, and why was the listing considered historic for European quantum computing?

golds.fact: IQM listed on Nasdaq in the US on 2 July 2026 and on the Helsinki exchange on 3 July, becoming the first European quantum computing company to go public, at a valuation of about $1.9 billion (roughly €1.7 billion), raising €337 million via a SPAC merger structure

question: Vad blev Maersks nettovinst för andra kvartalet 2026, och hur ändrade bolaget sin helårsprognos?

golds.fact: Maersk more than doubled its Q2 2026 net profit to $1.3 billion (about DKK 8.5 billion) on revenue of $15.8 billion (up 20 percent), and raised its full-year 2026 underlying EBITDA guidance to $10.5-12.5 billion from $8-10 billion

question: Vilken sanktionsavgift beslutade IMY om mot Sportadmin i Skandinavien AB i januari 2026 efter it-angreppet där uppgifter om över två miljoner personer läckte, och vilken artikel i dataskyddsförordningen ansågs överträdd?

golds.fact: IMY beslutade den 26 januari 2026 om en administrativ sanktionsavgift på 6 miljoner kronor mot Sportadmin i Skandinavien AB för överträdelse av artikel 32.1 GDPR, efter ett it-angrepp i januari 2025 där en hotaktör kom över personuppgifter om över 2,1 miljoner personer

question: När beslutade regeringen om Sveriges första heltäckande AI-strategi och vilket övergripande mål sätter strategin för Sveriges internationella position inom AI?

golds.fact: Regeringen presenterade den 20 februari 2026 Sveriges första heltäckande AI-strategi med målet att Sverige ska vara bland de tio främsta länderna i världen inom AI och bäst i världen på AI i offentlig förvaltning

Strategin åtföljs av en handlingsplan som konkretiserar beslutade och planerade åtgärder, bland annat en AI-verkstad för offentlig förvaltning, stöd till AI-fabriken Mimer vid Linköpings universitet och satsningar på svenska språkmodeller

question: När öppnade AI-verkstaden för offentlig förvaltning sin pilotverksamhet och hur många pilotorganisationer deltog vid starten?

golds.fact: AI-verkstaden för offentlig förvaltning, som drivs av Skatteverket och Försäkringskassan, öppnade sin pilotverksamhet den 1 juli 2026 med tio pilotorganisationer, däribland Region Halland och Mörbylånga kommun; full utbyggnad siktar mot 2030

question: Hur stort överträdelsegebyr fick Elkjøp av norska Datatilsynet i juni 2026 och vad gällde överträdelsen?

golds.fact: Datatilsynet i Norge ila Elkjøp Nordic AS och Elkjøp Norge AS ett överträdelsegebyr på 20 miljoner norska kronor (publicerat 4 juni 2026) för att ha behandlat personuppgifter i kundklubben utan giltigt samtycke, vilket berörde över sex miljoner medlemmar i Norden

question: Vad blev utfallet av danska Datatilsynets slutliga avgörande i Chromebook-ärendet i februari 2026 för de 51 berörda kommunerna?

golds.fact: Danska Datatilsynet uttalade den 2 februari 2026 allvarlig kritik mot 51 kommuner i Chromebook-ärendet om användningen av Googles produkter i folkskolan, med varning om att fortsatt bristande konfiguration och användning av underdatabehandlare i tredjeländer sannolikt strider mot dataskyddsförordningen

question: Vilka tre storskaliga AI-projekt i den offentliga sektorn enades den danska regeringen, KL och Danske Regioner om i december 2025, och hur mycket finansiering avsattes?

golds.fact: Den danska regeringen, KL och Danske Regioner ingick den 15 december 2025 en aftale om tre storskalaprojekt med AI i offentlig sektor – automatiserad dokumentation (tal-till-text), digital assistent för medborgare och företag, samt digitala assistenter/beslutsstöd för medarbetare – med 266,7 miljoner danska kronor i finansiering och utrullning från 2026

question: How large was the administrative fine imposed on S-Bank by the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman's sanctions board in September 2025, and what security failure triggered it?

golds.fact: On 10 September 2025 the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman's sanctions board imposed a EUR 1.8 million administrative fine on S-Pankki (S-Bank) over a software vulnerability in the S-mobiili app's login that for over three months in 2022 let users access online banking with another customer's credentials

question: What did the EU General Court rule on 3 September 2025 in Latombe v Commission (T-553/23) concerning the validity of the EU–US Data Privacy Framework?

golds.fact: The General Court dismissed the action for annulment of the EU–US Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision, confirming the US ensured an adequate level of protection for personal data transferred from the EU at the date the decision was adopted

The ruling means companies can continue relying on the DPF for transatlantic transfers, with the court holding the Data Protection Review Court offers sufficient independence safeguards; the judgment remains appealable to the Court of Justice

question: How did the Court of Justice's 4 September 2025 judgment in EDPS v SRB (C-413/23 P) change the assessment of whether pseudonymised data transferred to a third party counts as personal data?

golds.fact: In Case C-413/23 P (EDPS v SRB) the Court of Justice clarified that pseudonymised data transferred to a third party is personal data depending on whether the recipient has reasonable means to re-identify individuals — not on the pseudonymisation alone

The CJEU set aside the 2023 General Court ruling and endorsed a recipient-specific assessment: pseudonymised information may not be personal data for a recipient lacking reasonable means of re-identification, while the transferring controller's transparency duties still applied

question: Vilket agerande låg bakom EU-kommissionens beslut att bötfälla Google med 2,95 miljarder euro i adtech-ärendet den 5 september 2025, och vilka åtgärder ålades bolaget?

golds.fact: On 5 September 2025 the Commission fined Google EUR 2.95 billion for abusing dominance in adtech by self-preferencing its ad exchange AdX in the ad selection process run by its publisher ad server, and ordered it to end the self-preferencing and address conflicts of interest
DFP informed AdX in advance of the value of the best bid from competing exchanges; Google was given 60 days to submit a compliance plan and announced it would appeal

question: När blev EU:s dataförordning (Data Act) tillämplig, och vilka centrala rättigheter till dataåtkomst infördes för användare av uppkopplade produkter?

golds.fact: The Data Act became applicable on 12 September 2025 (20 months after entry into force on 11 January 2024), giving users of connected devices the right to access the data those devices generate and share it with third parties, and enabling cloud switching

question: How many incidents did the ENISA Threat Landscape 2025 report analyse, over what period, and what was identified as the dominant initial intrusion vector?

golds.fact: The ENISA Threat Landscape 2025, published in October 2025, analyses 4,875 incidents covering 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025 using a threat-centric approach
Phishing was the primary method for initial intrusion at around 60% of observed cases, with vulnerability exploitation at 21.3%; ransomware remained the most impactful threat

question: What DSA breaches did the European Commission preliminarily find TikTok and Meta responsible for on 24 October 2025?

golds.fact: On 24 October 2025 the Commission preliminarily found both TikTok and Meta in breach of their DSA obligation to grant researchers adequate access to public data, and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) additionally in breach of obligations on simple illegal-content notice mechanisms and effective challenge of content moderation decisions

Meta's interface designs were suspected of constituting dark patterns discouraging users from reporting illegal content or appealing moderation decisions; confirmed breaches can carry fines up to 6% of global turnover

question: För vilka överträdelser fick X EU-kommissionens första sanktionsbeslut enligt DSA i december 2025, och hur stor blev boten?

golds.fact: On 5 December 2025 the Commission fined X €120 million in the first non-compliance decision under the DSA, for the deceptive design of the paid 'blue checkmark', an inadequate advertising repository, and failure to give researchers access to public data
X was given 90 days to bring the platform into compliance or face additional penalties

question: What did the CJEU Grand Chamber decide on 10 February 2026 in WhatsApp Ireland v EDPB (C-97/23 P) about judicial review of EDPB binding decisions?

golds.fact: On 10 February 2026 the CJEU Grand Chamber held in C-97/23 P (WhatsApp Ireland v EDPB) that EDPB binding decisions under Article 65 GDPR are reviewable acts that data controllers can challenge directly before EU courts, setting aside the General Court's inadmissibility order
The Court found the EDPB decision definitively determined the Board's position, giving organizations direct EU-level recourse instead of depending on national courts referring questions to the CJEU

question: Under what conditions did the CJEU rule on 18 June 2026 in NTH Haustechnik (C-484/24) that national courts may use unlawfully obtained personal data as evidence?

golds.fact: In its 18 June 2026 judgment in C-484/24 (NTH Haustechnik v EM) the CJEU held that the GDPR does not absolutely prohibit courts from using unlawfully obtained personal data as evidence, requiring a legal basis under national law and a strict proportionality and data-minimisation assessment

The case arose from a German employment dispute where an employer accessed a former employee's private eBay account; the Court said courts must limit disclosure to what is necessary and consider protective measures such as anonymisation

question: What draft guidelines on anonymisation did the EDPB adopt in July 2026, and what three-criteria test do they establish for anonymous data?

golds.fact: In July 2026 the EDPB adopted draft Guidelines 02/2026 on Anonymisation for public consultation until 30 October 2026, setting a framework based on three criteria — no record isolation, no linkage, and no inference — alongside new web scraping guidance and final blockchain guidelines

The draft guidelines take a relative approach to identifiability, so the same dataset may be personal data for one organisation and anonymous for another, replacing the 2014 Article 29 Working Party opinion

question: What is Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (the Digital Omnibus on AI), when did it enter into force, and what are the new deadlines for high-risk AI system obligations under the AI Act?

golds.fact: The AI Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026, deferring the AI Act's high-risk obligations to 2 December 2027 for Annex III systems and 2 August 2028 for high-risk AI embedded in products, while extending SME-style simplifications and preserving safeguards
The Digital Omnibus on AI was adopted as Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, published in the Official Journal on 24 July 2026 and entering into force on the third day following publication, 27 July 2026

question: Från vilket datum kunde EU-kommissionens AI-byrå börja utöva tillsyn över leverantörer av AI-modeller för allmänna ändamål enligt AI-förordningen, och vad är den maximala sanktionsavgiften?

golds.fact: The Commission's (AI Office's) enforcement powers over GPAI model providers became applicable on 2 August 2026, with fines of up to €15 million or 3% of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher
From 2 August 2026 the AI Office and national authorities began enforcing GPAI rules, alongside new transparency obligations covering chatbots, deepfakes and machine-generated content
